capture_method: Textual app run_test/save_screenshot; rendered application UI, not desktop screen captures or mockups.

screenshots.title: Start without an API key
screenshots.description: Bundled retail data, example questions and a visible Demo mode indicator.
screenshots.source: Actual empty app state; no model call.

screenshots.title: Ask questions in demo mode
screenshots.description: Net revenue and the top five products, with a separate View results button for each answer.
screenshots.source: Actual offline calculations on bundled retail data.

screenshots.title: Preview your CSV before importing
screenshots.description: The import preview shows 244 rows, inferred column types and empty-cell counts.
screenshots.source: Actual CSV inspection. File selection supplied directly; native Finder is not shown.

screenshots.title: Read a formatted AI answer
screenshots.description: A supermarket analysis displays a proper table, an explicit branch filter and answer-specific evidence.
screenshots.source: Saved answer from the successful live AI evaluation, replayed with locally verified SQL; no new API call.

screenshots.title: Keep writing while the answer is loading
screenshots.description: The submitted question and Thinking indicator are visible. The next draft is editable while Ask is disabled.
screenshots.source: Actual pending UI state with a controlled delayed test response; no live request.

screenshots.title: Inspect the exact result rows
screenshots.description: The result view belongs to this answer and identifies the dataset used.
screenshots.source: Actual result viewer, using the replayed query results.

screenshots.title: Inspect the SQL behind the answer
screenshots.description: The executed query shows the aggregation, branch filter and grouping.
screenshots.source: Actual SQL tab for the same answer.

screenshots.title: Refine a question across follow-ups
screenshots.description: Dinner → Sunday dinner → non-smokers, retaining earlier filters and showing evidence for each answer.
screenshots.source: Three saved live AI answers; all queries rerun against tips.csv and matched to the recorded results.

screenshots.title: Remember a confirmed column meaning
screenshots.description: A confirmation produces a Definition saved notice and the verified size-6 result: average tip 5.225 across 4 rows.
screenshots.source: Saved live AI responses replayed through the real confirmation-saving workflow and real SQL.

screenshots.title: Choose where to save all chat results
screenshots.description: The confirmation lists three result CSV files plus an index and query details. Cancel preserves the visible draft.
screenshots.source: Actual export flow after supplying a destination. Native Finder is not shown. Cancel was exercised; no export was written.

screenshots.title: Return to a saved conversation
screenshots.description: Conversations across retail, supermarket and tips data are labelled with their dataset.
screenshots.source: Actual saved-chat selector populated only with disposable demonstration chats.

screenshots.title: Connect your own AI account
screenshots.description: An empty API-key field, a model field, optional Test connection and session-key guidance. No credential is included.
screenshots.source: Actual AI settings dialog in an unconfigured state; no key and no connection test.
